name: Proxima c
tagline: Um candidato disputado de super-Terra bem fora da zona habitável — o irmão frio e lento de Proxima.
history: Proxima c emerged from radial-velocity data as a ~7-Earth-mass signal circling the red dwarf every five and a half years at about 1.5 AU — a mini-Neptune or super-Earth frozen far outside the habitable zone. It remains unconfirmed: follow-up HARPS and astrometric work keep the candidate alive but not settled, and some analyses dispute the signal entirely. If real, its unusually wide orbit makes it a prime candidate for direct imaging — one of the very few exoplanets next door we might one day photograph as a separate point of light.
